changelog:
Added:
- Add `nodejs.org` to the npm network preset ([#18](https://github.com/bernd/vibepit/pull/18))
- Add a Git config that makes GitHub SSH remotes (`git@github.com:`) use HTTPS, since SSH traffic is blocked in the sandbox ([#19](https://github.com/bernd/vibepit/pull/19))
- Add a `--memory`/`-m` flag and `memory` config option to cap the sandbox's memory, like `docker run --memory`; `0` disables a limit set elsewhere ([#27](https://github.com/bernd/vibepit/pull/27))
- Add a HOSTS tab to `vibepit monitor` that lists every host the sandbox contacts, shows which are blocked, and lets you allow them directly
- Add support for the kitty terminal (`TERM=xterm-kitty`) in the sandbox

Changed:
- Warn in `run` and `up` about sandbox flags that are ignored because a session is already running
- Update to Go 1.27.2

Fixed:
- Fix `--reconfigure` dropping other project settings and comments
- Fix IPv6 lookups of `host.vibepit` showing up as blocked
